query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

parts.text:
*(You stand on the quarterdeck, one hand resting on the hilt of your cutlass, the other gripping the wooden railing. Below you, the crew grumbles, weary from weeks of calm seas and watered-down grog. You take a deep breath of the salty air, step forward, and raise your voice to pierce the wind.)*

"Gather ’round, ye bilge rats! Lay down your ropes, leave your dice, and bring your weary bones to the main deck! 

Look at ye. Starin' at the horizon with empty pockets, bellies full of nothing but hardtack, and dreams no bigger than the bottom of an empty mug. Are ye the terrors of the seven seas, or a pack of wet hens waiting for the tide to drown ye? 

*No!* We are the lords of the tide! We are the free souls of the deep! 

And look what I hold in me hand..."

*(You pull a weathered, salt-crusted piece of parchment from your vest and unfurl it with a snap. The crew leans in, their eyes catching the faint outlines of ink and charcoal.)*

"This ain't some merchant’s ledger, lads. This is the map to the Black Spit. The legendary resting place of Captain Morgan’s lost vanguard. It’s been buried in the dark, away from the sun, just waiting for men with enough steel in their spines to go and claim it! 

We're talking chests of gold doubloons stacked higher than the mainmast. Emeralds as green as the deep sea, rubies as red as the blood of our enemies, and silver enough to buy the very taverns we’ve been kicked out of! Every man jack of ye will be walking into Tortuga draped in silks, with gold teeth and a belly full of the finest rum money can buy. Ye won't just be rich—ye’ll be kings!

Aye, I know what they say. The harbor masters whisper that the Spit is cursed. They say the reefs are jagged teeth waiting to rip the bottom out of the *Siren's Grace*. They say the spirits of the dead guard the hoard. 

But I ask ye this: since when does the Jolly Roger fly for cowards? Since when do we let a few old ghosts and a bit of shallow water stand between us and our destiny? We’ve sailed through typhoons that would make the Royal Navy weep! We’ve fought beasts of the deep and lived to laugh about it! 

We share the sweat, we share the danger, and by the gods, we share the plunder! Equal shares for all, and a double portion for the brave soul who spots the shore first! 

There is a fortune waiting for us out there, just beyond the horizon, buried in the sand. All we have to do is go and take it! 

So, I ask ye now... who is with me? Who wants to die a peasant, and who wants to live forever as a legend?!"

*(You draw your cutlass and point it toward the sky.)*

"Hoist the black flag! Weigh the anchor! Let’s catch the wind and go rob the devil himself! To the rigging, ye beautiful scoundrels! *To gold and glory!*"
